test_inputs.explanation: The execution repeatedly stayed on the admin sales order grid URL (/admin/sales_order/), which is where Magento's mass actions (Cancel, Hold, Print, etc.) are performed. No explicit filter changes (like status selection) are visible in the trace, so 'filter_status' is omitted. A common and valid mass action that works reliably on most orders is 'Cancel', and using 'select_visible': true matches the behavior of selecting multiple orders at once from the grid. These values conform to the tool schema and should replay successfully on the same page.
